verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a public developer API: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an Agent API for web-grounded answers with citations, a raw Search API, and embeddings. It also documents structured output, model fallback, and versioned profiles, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json plus an llms.txt index. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API reliability, and evidence that consumer-app features such as Library, Spaces or the Assistant are reachable via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Unified access to open-weight models hosted by Perplexity through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call, and conversation context across turns.
Get raw, ranked web search results with advanced filtering and real-time data.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Structured output makes the model return JSON that conforms to a schema you define, so you can deserialize it directly.
